NetworkZone.description: Road network zone (area grouping of links/nodes).

typeId.description: Zone type classification (e.g. electoral ward, incident area).
typeId.title: TypeId

permanent.description: Whether this is a permanent or temporary zone. Absent means permanent (the v1 default for a zone).

items.description: Unique identifier of an object. String of 1-32 characters from A-Z, a-z, 0-9 and . _ : - (no spaces), unique within object type within system.
items.title: ObjectId

linkIds.description: The links that make up the zone, as a set: the order of the array carries no meaning (v1 describes a zone as an unordered sequence of links). Omit the field rather than send an empty list. Each link appears at most once.

geometry.description: Zone boundary geometry as GeoJSON LineString.

NetworkZone.title: UTMC Network Zone
